categories.main_business_segments: Billion Electric Co., Ltd. operates primarily in electronic components, ICT products, renewable energy equipment, and system integration. Its core business includes power supply products, communication products (such as 5G/LTE routers and industrial routers), customized energy storage and power products, and renewable energy solutions including solar power plants and energy management systems. The company also provides energy trading and engineering services, focusing on smart grid and sustainable energy applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in switching power supplies, LED drivers, 5G/LTE wireless communication, and modular energy storage systems compliant with UL and IEC standards. It integrates energy management systems (EMS), power conversion systems (PCS), and battery management systems (BMS) for customized energy solutions. Production methods include design, manufacturing, system integration, and engineering construction with a focus on vertical integration from component development to maintenance services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include telecommunications operators, industrial and power sectors, smart transportation, renewable energy developers, and commercial and industrial energy users. The company serves markets requiring 5G/LTE communication equipment, energy storage solutions, solar power plant equipment, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. Major markets include utility companies, system integrators, and end-users in smart grid and green energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Billion Electric operates mainly in Taiwan with subsidiaries and investments in the United States, Japan, Singapore, and Seychelles. Its sales and operations cover Asia, the Americas, Europe, and Oceania, with significant market presence in Taiwan, North America, Australia, and Japan. The company has direct offices and warehouses in Taiwan and engages in international markets through subsidiaries and partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and manufactures electronic and energy products, integrates systems, and provides engineering, installation, and maintenance services. It also acts as an energy aggregator and trading agent, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the renewable energy and communication equipment value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding renewable energy and energy storage business, developing AI-driven energy management and optimization technologies, and enhancing 5G/LTE communication product lines. The company focuses on vertical and horizontal integration of energy systems, smart grid solutions, and energy-as-a-service (EaaS) models. R&D initiatives target high-efficiency power supplies, digital control technologies, integrated solar and storage platforms, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of power supplies, communication devices, solar and energy storage equipment, and related system integration services. Additional income comes from engineering contracts, energy trading services, and after-sales maintenance and operation (O&M) services. The company also earns from licensing and strategic partnerships in renewable energy projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the power supply and energy management sector, the company faces competition based on efficiency, price, technology innovation, and reliability. In network communication products, competitors include companies like Zyxel, Senao, Smawave, and Robustel. Billion Electric positions itself as a technology leader with diversified product lines, strong R&D capabilities, and integrated renewable energy solutions, maintaining competitive advantages in Taiwan and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$2.02 billion in 2023, representing a 10.67% increase from the previous year. Despite revenue growth driven by energy storage business expansion, it recorded a net loss attributable to the parent company of NT$24.75 million in 2023, compared to net profit in the prior year. The company maintains substantial assets totaling over NT$2.5 billion and continues investing in subsidiaries and technology development, indicating a growth-oriented but currently loss-making profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Billion Electric emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop energy system integration capability, combining product design, manufacturing, system integration, and maintenance services. Its modular, high-stability energy storage solutions meet international safety standards, supported by proprietary EMS and AI-based energy optimization. The company differentiates through vertical and horizontal integration of renewable energy technologies, strong R&D in 5G communication and power electronics, and a commitment to sustainable, smart energy solutions tailored to customer needs.
